description: Server-side flashbangs for Minecraft 26.3 Fabric, with custom models, frozen afterimages and sound effects.

mods.name: BongoFlashbangs
mods.description: Server-side flashbangs with scaled sulfur-cube physics, a custom item model, and weak/medium/full frozen afterimages selected by distance and viewing angle.

releases.notes:
BongoFlashbangs 0.6.0 for Minecraft Java 26.3.

- Server-side flashbangs with bouncing sulfur-cube physics, custom item models, crafting and weak/medium/full flash effects.
- Frozen afterimages, directional exposure, wall occlusion and a delayed ear-ringing sound after full exposure.

Installation: put `BongoFlashbangs-0.6.0.jar` in the server's `mods` directory. Requires Java 25, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3. Players need the matching resource-pack ZIP, but no client mod. The pack may also be served through Minecraft's server resource-pack settings.

Validation before publication: clean source copy built successfully; exposure, model and sound-resource checks passed; all six effect profiles passed ShaderC and OpenGL GPU checks. The JAR and resource-pack archive contents match the previously prepared 0.6.0 artifacts. Earlier dedicated-server verification and its limits are documented in the repository. No new full-client visual or listening test was performed.
